Fires on the separator token (comma, closing curly quote, or space) that sits at the boundary between the first part of a two-part title or bibliographic citation and its continuation (e.g. the "," in "I, Claudius", the ",”" after "Quiz Show", the space after "Sam."/"II,"); it is strongly suppressed by tokens that are the *continuation* word of such compound titles ("Boris" Godunov, Captain "America").
